title: Chosen and Set Apart
story:
A teacher once selected a few students for a special school project.

Many students applied.

Everyone wanted to be chosen.

When the list was announced, only a few names were called.

Those students felt surprised and honored.

One student asked,

“Why were we chosen?”

The teacher replied,

“It is not because you are the most talented.”

“It is because I see something special in you.”

“You are set apart for this task.”

The students felt valued and confident.

In life, many people feel ordinary.

Unnoticed.

Unimportant.

But God’s choice is different.

He chooses not based on status.

But based on His love and purpose.

He calls people His own.

And sets them apart for something meaningful.
life_lesson: You are chosen by God and set apart for His purpose.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for choosing me and calling me Your own.

Help me to understand my identity in You.

Remove feelings of being ordinary or forgotten.

Let me walk confidently in Your purpose.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes feel ordinary or unnoticed?

How does it change you to know God has chosen you?

What purpose might God be setting you apart for today?
verse:
For you are a people holy to the Lord your God.
The Lord your God has chosen you to be His treasured possession.
